import numpy as np

# Data for CY 1963-1977 (convertible foreign currencies in millions of dollars)
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
mean = np.mean(data)
print(f"Data: {data}")
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Sample standard deviation
s = np.std(data, ddof=1)
print(f"Sample Std Dev (s): {s}")

# Calculate Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness
# g1 = (n / ((n-1)(n-2))) * Σ[(xi - x̄)³ / s³]

# Calculate the sum of (xi - mean)^3 / s^3
sum_cubed = sum(((x - mean) ** 3) / (s ** 3) for x in data)
print(f"Sum of ((xi - mean)^3 / s^3): {sum_cubed}")

# Fisher-Pearson coefficient
g1 = (n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))) * sum_cubed
print(f"Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness: {g1}")

# Round to nearest thousandths
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(g1, 3)}")
EOF
